I farm 10.1 mu with a wheat-maize rotation, so I will keep the full area in winter wheat and then full area in summer maize. I have 40 years of experience and access to well irrigation, but my household is small and some labor is off-farm, so I will keep the plan stable, practical, and not too labor-intensive. For wheat, I will use improved seed, steady fertilizer, and a moderate number of irrigations because wheat in my area responds well to water at key stages and I can support that with my well. For summer maize, I will use hybrid seed because I want strong yield and better stand performance, and I will keep fertilizer and irrigation at a level I can manage reliably. I will use rotary tillage because it fits my scale and saves labor compared with heavy ploughing. I will not push inputs too aggressively; I want dependable output, manageable cost, and lower risk across the whole year.
